items.title: George "Jug" Jernberg Interview, 1963-08-23
items.q: To be very truthful with you, I never cared much for him.

ctx.x: from New Orleans. I'm pretty sure that he worked in New Orleans before... before he ever came to Chicago. But... Maxson could shoot the bull something awful... also. So...
To be very truthful with you, I never cared much for him. .
Who do you remember from the New Orleans gang playing at Shields Impresso?
